Amravati Expressway Accident Kills Seven, Injures 19

A road accident on the Samruddhi Expressway near Amravati, Maharashtra, resulted in the deaths of seven people and injuries to 19 others. The incident occurred when a truck collided with a Bolero pickup van, also referred to as a tempo. Initial reports indicated five fatalities and 21 injuries, but subsequent coverage stated seven deaths and 19 injuries.
